_note: Events with choices (docs/PLAN-M14.md). Triggers live in src/sim/events.ts; everything else is here. An event waits patienceDays for an answer, then its `ignored` effect happens. Effects: resources (added; negative is a cost, and a choice you can't afford is greyed out), mood (happiness for everyone, easing off over its days), message, deposit (the hole gains it), openCavity (the lava tube's cells, dug free), holdDrillDays, conditionFloorAbove (condition lost by the rooms on the floor above the find), colonists, notableRole (one of the newcomers becomes a notable with that role), followUp (an effect some days later), celebrate (propose a celebration for that milestone), festival, landing (the lander comes down on the pad), ventAir (the air's O2 above the target vented to the planet, lost for good). Depth limits (#390, sim/depth.ts, data/depth.json): limit (soft or hard) marks the events the drill raises at a hidden limit; waits: the card has no timer and the drill holds until it's answered. repairDrill (pay the drill's repair, data/depth.json, and dig on), capHole (cap the hole for good, named by that ending), scrapDrill (half the drill's materials back), crateDrill (crate the drill for this hole's next seed kit), unlock (a room gate, such as geothermal). Placeholders: {floor}, {ship}, {milestone}, {o2}, {plaque}, and in hints {repair}, {scrap} and {crate} (the drill's costs, from depth.json).

celebrations._note: The milestones a hole celebrates are those with celebrate: true in data/milestones.json, once each. A festival costs `feast` meals (or rations, if meals run short), lifts everyone for `days`, and the first `workDays` run at `productivity`.

ventAir._note: Too much oxygen (PLAN-M16 step 5): above air.o2High (config.json) a fire-risk warning, and after afterDays above it the vent_air card, at most once every cooldownDays; the warning at most once every warnEveryDays. label names the vented O2 in the flows.
ventAir.label: Vented
ventAir.warning: Fire risk: the air's at {o2} oxygen. Anything that sparks burns hotter.

grayOverflow._note: Full gray-water tanks (T-148): rooms keep running and the gray water that doesn't fit is lost for good. This warning, at most once every warnEveryDays.
grayOverflow.warning: Gray water overflowing: the tanks are full and water is being lost for good. Build a water recycler, or a tank set to hold gray water.

events.title: Too much oxygen
events.text: The air's at {o2} oxygen, and there's nowhere left to store it. The fire crews are nervous.

ignored.message: Nobody decided about the oxygen: it's held, and the fire risk stays.

choices.label: Vent the excess
choices.hint: Oxygen back to 21%. What's vented is lost to the planet for good.
choices.message: The excess oxygen is vented to the planet. The air's back to 21%.

choices.label: Hold it
choices.hint: Keep it, and build gas tanks for it instead. The fire-risk warning stays.
choices.message: The oxygen is held. The fire crews are keeping an eye on it.

events.title: Time to celebrate: {milestone}
events.text: {milestone}! People want to mark it. A festival would cost a feast and a month of slow work, but it's the kind of thing people remember.

ignored.message: {milestone}: marked with a quiet toast or two.

choices.label: Throw a festival
choices.hint: A feast (30 meals, or rations), lanterns in the shaft, and a month of slow work (80%). Everyone's lifted (+8 happiness, easing off over two months).
choices.message: A festival for {milestone}! Lanterns are going up the shaft.

choices.label: Raise a toast
choices.hint: A small lift (+2 happiness for a couple of months).
choices.message: A toast to {milestone}.

events.title: Mayday from the {ship}
events.text: A belt freighter, the {ship}, is calling on every frequency: her drive is failing and her six crew are running out of air. She could make it down to our pad, or limp on if someone sends supplies up.

ignored.message: The {ship} went quiet. Nobody answered her, and people know it.

choices.label: Bring them down
choices.hint: 30 oxygen and 30 water. Her six crew join us, with their salvage (15 electronics, 10 machinery); their pilot becomes a notable.
choices.message: The {ship} came down on our pad: six belters, safe, and their salvage. Everyone turned out to see.

choices.label: Send supplies up
choices.hint: 60 oxygen and 60 water. They limp on, and the belt doesn't forget: a thank-you drop in 10–15 months.

effect.message: A drop from the belt, with thanks from the crew we helped: 20 electronics, 15 machinery.

choices.message: Supplies went up to the {ship}. She limps on toward Ceres.

choices.label: Ignore the call
choices.hint: Keep what we have. People won't like it (−5 happiness).
choices.message: We let the {ship} go. People are quiet about it.

events.title: The drill struck water
events.text: Floor {floor}: the cutterhead broke into a layer of wet rock, and water is seeping into the bore. An aquifer, right under us.

ignored.message: Nobody decided about the aquifer on floor {floor}: the drill crew sealed it and carried on.

choices.label: Tap it
choices.hint: The hole gains the aquifer (deep well pumps), and 150 water now.
choices.message: The aquifer on floor {floor} is tapped: deep well pumps can draw on it.

choices.label: Seal it pristine
choices.hint: Leave Mars's water untouched. Everyone's a little proud (+4 happiness for a few months).
choices.message: The aquifer on floor {floor} is sealed, untouched. People are proud of that.

events.title: A rich ore vein
events.text: Floor {floor}: the spoil coming up the conveyor is heavy and dark. The drill has cut a vein of iron ore.

ignored.message: The ore vein on floor {floor} was left alone.

choices.label: Work the vein
choices.hint: The hole gains the ore deposit (smelters; digging brings up ore), and 60 ore now.
choices.message: The ore vein on floor {floor} is being worked.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.hint: Nothing changes.

events.title: A bed of silica sand
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill is bringing up fine pale sand. Silica: the stuff of glass and wafers.

ignored.message: The silica bed on floor {floor} was left alone.

choices.label: Work the bed
choices.hint: The hole gains the silica deposit (digging brings up silica), and 60 silica now.
choices.message: The silica bed on floor {floor} is being worked.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.hint: Nothing changes.

events.title: A lava tube
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill broke into a hollow. An old lava tube runs off from the shaft, smooth-walled and dry.

ignored.message: The lava tube on floor {floor} was left: the crew walled it off.

choices.label: Open it up
choices.hint: A run of empty space on floor {floor}, dug out for free, ready to build in.
choices.message: The lava tube on floor {floor} is opened up: free space to build in.

choices.label: Mine its walls
choices.hint: 200 rock from its walls; the space stays rock.
choices.message: The lava tube's walls on floor {floor} are mined for rock.

events.title: Gas in the bore
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill has opened a pocket of gas. The sensors are complaining and the crew wants to know how careful to be.

ignored.message: With nobody deciding, the drill crew vented the gas slowly: a month lost.

choices.label: Vent it slowly
choices.hint: Safe, but the drill loses a month.
choices.message: The gas on floor {floor} is vented slowly: the drill is back at it next month.

choices.label: Push through
choices.hint: Keep drilling: the rooms on the floor above lose 20 condition to the fumes, and people are rattled (−4 happiness for a few months).
choices.message: The drill pushed through the gas on floor {floor}. The floor above smells of it.

events.title: Microfossils!
events.text: Floor {floor}: in the spoil, under a hand lens, tiny ordered shapes. Something lived here once. The scientists want the drill stopped.

ignored.message: Nobody stopped the drill for the microfossils, and the scientists are sulking.

choices.label: Stop and study them
choices.hint: The drill stops for 2 months. Everyone's thrilled (+10 happiness), and it's worth a celebration.
choices.message: Life on Mars, once: the microfossils from floor {floor} are being studied.

choices.label: Dig on
choices.hint: No time lost; the scientists sulk (−5 happiness).
choices.message: The drill digs on past the microfossils. The scientists are not pleased.

events.title: The drill has broken down
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill's main bearing has seized, and the gearbox with it. The crew can rebuild it, or call it a day for this hole.

choices.label: Repair it and dig on
choices.hint: Rebuild the bearing and the gearbox ({repair}).
choices.message: The drill is rebuilt and turning again below floor {floor}.

choices.label: Stop here, and scrap the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good: no more floors. The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Stop here, and crate the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good. The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: A layer of hard basalt
events.text: Floor {floor}: the cutterhead has hit a sheet of basalt, harder than anything above it. The bit is worn to a stub.

choices.label: Fit a new bit and dig on
choices.hint: A new cutter bit, for basalt ({repair}).
choices.message: A new bit is on, and the drill grinds on into the basalt below floor {floor}.

choices.label: Stop here, and scrap the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good: no more floors. The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Stop here, and crate the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good. The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: Groundwater in the bore
events.text: Floor {floor}: water is flooding in faster than the drill can clear it. Pumps would keep it dry; or the bore could be sealed here.

choices.label: Pump it and dig on
choices.hint: Pumps to keep the bore dry ({repair}).
choices.message: The pumps are running and the bore below floor {floor} is dry enough to dig.

choices.label: Stop here, and scrap the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good: no more floors. The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Stop here, and crate the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good. The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: Tremors
events.text: Floor {floor}: the ground keeps shaking, and the bore walls are cracking. Shoring would make it safe to go deeper.

choices.label: Reinforce the shaft and dig on
choices.hint: Steel shoring down the bore ({repair}).
choices.message: The shaft is shored up below floor {floor}, and the drill digs on.

choices.label: Stop here, and scrap the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good: no more floors. The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Stop here, and crate the drill
choices.hint: The hole is capped for good. The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: A geothermal pocket
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill has broken into hot, unstable rock. Going deeper would risk the whole hole: this is as far as it goes. But the heat down there could be put to work.

choices.label: Turn the drill into a geothermal plant
choices.hint: The drill's pumps and casing become a heat well: this hole can build a geothermal plant, the only way to get one. Everyone's proud of it (+4 happiness).
choices.message: The drill on floor {floor} becomes a heat well: a geothermal plant can be built here.

choices.label: Deconstruct the drill
choices.hint: The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Crate the drill
choices.hint: The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: A deep reservoir
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill has broken into a reservoir of ancient water, too deep and too wide to drill through. This is the bottom of the hole.

choices.label: Turn the drill into a deep water pump
choices.hint: The drill's string becomes a pump: the hole gains the aquifer (deep well pumps), and 300 water now.
choices.message: The drill on floor {floor} is a deep water pump now, drawing on the reservoir below.

choices.label: Deconstruct the drill
choices.hint: The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Crate the drill
choices.hint: The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: A brine lake
events.text: Floor {floor}: under the rock, a lake of salty brine, thick with minerals. The drill can't go through it.

choices.label: Turn the drill into a brine works
choices.hint: The drill pumps the brine up and boils it down: 80 ore, 80 silica and 120 water now.
choices.message: The drill on floor {floor} pumps brine up for its salts and minerals.

choices.label: Deconstruct the drill
choices.hint: The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Crate the drill
choices.hint: The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: An old magma chamber
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill has broken into a great hollow where magma once pooled, long cold. Below it, the rock is too broken to drill.

choices.label: Open up the chamber
choices.hint: A big run of empty space on floor {floor}, dug out for free, ready to build in. The drill's lights are left up in the vault.
choices.message: The old magma chamber on floor {floor} is opened up: a cavern to build in.

choices.label: Deconstruct the drill
choices.hint: The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Crate the drill
choices.hint: The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: A fault line
events.text: Floor {floor}: the drill has reached a fault in the crust. The rock shifts under the bit; drilling on would bring the shaft down. There's nothing down here but bad luck.

choices.label: Deconstruct the drill
choices.hint: The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Crate the drill
choices.hint: The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

events.title: Stop drilling for good?
events.text: The crew can stop the drill here, at floor {floor}, and cap the hole: no more floors, ever. It can't be undone.

choices.label: Cap it, and scrap the drill
choices.hint: No more floors. The drill is broken down for parts ({scrap}).

choices.label: Cap it, and crate the drill
choices.hint: No more floors. The drill is crated for this hole's next seed kit: that kit needs {crate} less.

choices.label: Keep drilling
choices.hint: Nothing changes.
choices.message: The drill carries on.

events.title: The capping of {milestone}
events.text: The dig is done. A plaque goes up at the top of the shaft: “{plaque}”. People want to mark the end of it.

ignored.message: The hole is capped with a quiet toast or two.

choices.label: Throw a festival
choices.hint: A feast (30 meals, or rations), lanterns in the shaft, and a month of slow work (80%). Everyone's lifted (+8 happiness, easing off over two months).
choices.message: A festival for the capping! Lanterns are going up the shaft.

choices.label: Raise a toast
choices.hint: A small lift (+2 happiness for a couple of months).
choices.message: A toast to the end of the dig.
